title: Integrate European indexed graphics contexts
changes: Extend the indexed-graphics catalog with 33 source-authenticated four-byte contexts and serve their 132 bytes from typed fields in EUR dataset e159-d158, preserving guest arithmetic and raw fallback outside the selected extent.
Update indexed-graphics diagnostics and the prior model comparison to include the new source class while retaining the earlier archive projection.
validation: Windows GNU test executable built in unit e159-indexed-context-build-ordinary-v8dwm2f2. Wine unit e159-indexed-context-wine-8dbsgppp passed e158 file comparison, e159 creation/reuse, poisoned-source and boundary reads, malformed-model checks and 24 original-reader state/clock comparisons.

The same Wine test replayed 11 ordinary interpreter frames from an authenticated world-map input: four typed requests to context 3, zero raw context requests, matching state/clock, framebuffer, OAM and mixed audio.
limitations: Generated dispatch cases can use interpreter fallback. Full reader ABI, other ordinary contexts and consumers, production CLI on e159, broader Wine regressions, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. No performance measurement.
